title: Hydrogen bonding in water under extreme confinement
title_zh: 极端限域下水的氢键作用
abstract: Fluids under extreme confinement or near interfaces exhibit molecular structures and intermolecular bonding distinct from their bulk analogues. Optical vibrational studies have shown that interfacial and confined water can exhibit altered intramolecular O–H stretching frequencies, a sensitive spectral signature of changes in intermolecular hydrogen bonding1–4. Investigating confined water experimentally at the length scale of intermolecular and surface forces has, however, remained a challenge. Here we report direct molecular-level observations of hydrogen bonding in water confined inside individual carbon nanotubes (CNTs), enabled by in situ vibrational electron energy loss spectroscopy (vEELS) with nanoscale resolution. Water in larger CNTs exhibits the bonded O–H vibrations of bulk water, but at smaller diameters, and the frequency blueshifts to near the free O–H stretch found in water vapour and water located near hydrophobic surfaces, indicating a highly dispersed, non-H-bonded environment. Theoretical analysis based on quantum vibrational oscillators links the observed spectral features to local hydrogen-bonding configurations, consistent with the experimental observation. Furthermore, cryogenic experiments provide insights into complex structural phase transitions of confined water. This research reveals the quantum and dynamic nature of hydrogen bonds under confinement and the potential impact of unveiling molecular-level structure and bonding in confined fluids. A new technique allows direct nanoscale observations of the vibrational response of water confined inside carbon nanotubes, revealing that high degrees of confinement disrupt the hydrogen bond network through a fluctuating and highly-dispersed molecular state.
abstract_zh: 在极端限域或界面附近，流体的分子结构和分子间键合与其体相有显著差异。光谱振动研究表明，界面和限域水的内聚 O–H 拉伸频率有所改变，这是氢键变化的敏感光谱特征。然而，在分子间和表面力的长度尺度上实验性研究限域水一直面临挑战。本研究利用具有纳米分辨率的原位振动电子能量损失光谱（vEELS），在碳纳米管（CNTs）的单个空腔中直接观测到限域水的氢键作用。较大直径的 CNTs 中的水表现出体相水的键合 O–H 振动，但在较小直径下，频率蓝移至接近水蒸气和疏水表面附近水的自由 O–H 拉伸频率，表明分子状态高度分散、非氢键化。基于量子振动振子的理论分析将观测到的光谱特征与局部氢键构型联系起来，与实验观测一致。此外，低温实验提供了关于限域水复杂结构相转变的见解。该研究揭示了在限域下氢键的量子和动力学本质，以及揭示限域流体分子层面结构和键合的潜在影响。一种新技术允许直接纳米尺度观测碳纳米管中限域水的振动响应，显示高度限域会通过波动和高度分散的分子状态破坏氢键网络。
